ChromaLift is a free Windows gaming toolkit built to change the way your games look and feel: stronger colours, clearer enemy visibility, per-game profiles, resolution control, connection checks and reversible performance tweaks in one app.

Why ChromaLift

More control. More visibility.

Use one lightweight toolkit to tune the image, profiles, resolution, network checks and reversible Windows optimizations around the games you actually play.

Change almost everything you notice.

Push saturation, tune contrast and gamma, lift dark areas, save per-game looks, change resolution and refresh rate, build a custom crosshair, test your route and apply reversible Windows tweaks.

VISMake colours pop and improve visual separation so enemies and important details stand out more clearly.
FPSBoost can change selected Windows settings, but actual FPS gains depend on your hardware and workload.
PINGRun a plain-English connection test and watch live ping from the Network page.

Built outside the game process.

ChromaLift is designed as a Windows utility rather than a cheat or game modification. It does not inject code into your game process. That said, no software can honestly promise zero ban risk across every anti-cheat system, so always follow each game's rules.

FREENo subscription or paid tier: the project is free and open source under MIT.
LOCALSettings, logs and profiles stay on your PC instead of depending on a cloud profile.
SAFEResolution changes have an auto-revert window, Boost changes are reversible, and Emergency colour reset is built in.

Windows build

Build the desktop app.

The provided README instructs users to install Python 3.10+ and run the included build script. Inno Setup can then compile the installer.

1. Install Python 3.10+
2. Run build.bat
3. Optional: install Inno Setup
4. Compile installer.iss
Done
